name: Gaussian Splat Voxelization for Collision
definition: An algorithm that converts Gaussian splat data into a three-dimensional grid of occupied cells (voxels) to automatically generate a collision structure.
summary: Gaussian Splat Voxelization for Collision automatically generates watertight collision meshes from 3D Gaussian Splat data by converting density into a voxel grid, eliminating the need for manual mesh construction.
